description: Renewable projects require meaningful participation local benefit and ecological review.
Grid modernization should distribute reliability and cost benefits fairly.
Storage and microgrids should not be limited to wealthy households or regions.
Retrofits and heat pumps can improve health and affordability if designed for low-income access.
Transport electrification should include public transit freight workers and charging equity.
Phase-down requires wage security pensions cleanup and regional investment.
Industrial decarbonization must reduce pollution while protecting workers and communities.
Mineral supply chains require consent labor standards ecological protection and benefit sharing.
